# NaijaSinglesConnect

> A private matchmaking community for Nigerians seeking relationships that lead to marriage. Open to singles of every faith, in Nigeria and the diaspora. Every profile is reviewed by a person before other members can see it.

## How it works
- Create an account, then complete a profile covering faith, marriage intentions, family plans, genotype, children, location, education and work.
- Pay the membership fee by bank transfer and upload the receipt. The team approves profiles, usually within 24 hours, with support on WhatsApp.
- Approved members see compatible members ranked by how well their answers align. Deal-breakers, such as a different religion, are applied first.
- Genotype pairings that risk sickle cell disease are flagged before an introduction.

## Privacy
- Members choose a full profile, a profile without photographs, or a name-restricted profile showing only initials.
- Phone numbers, email addresses and payment details are never shown on profiles.
